findings.body: In DrawViewDimension::getRefTypeSubElements(), the function returns RefType::invalidRef when no subElements are provided, but this is incorrect for 3D reference validation. The function should return RefType::invalidRef for 3D references as well, since 3D references cannot be validated without 2D references. The comment '// TODO: Gui/DimensionValidators.cpp has almost the same code' indicates this is a known issue that should be fixed.
findings.note:
[P1] Invalid dimension reference type in DrawViewDimension::getRefTypeSubElements

In DrawViewDimension::getRefTypeSubElements(), the function returns RefType::invalidRef when no subElements are provided, but this is incorrect for 3D reference validation. The function should return RefType::invalidRef for 3D references as well, since 3D references cannot be validated without 2D references. The comment '// TODO: Gui/DimensionValidators.cpp has almost the same code' indicates this is a known issue that should be fixed.
findings.title: [P1] Invalid dimension reference type in DrawViewDimension::getRefTypeSubElements

overall.overall_explanation: The patch incorrectly returns RefType::invalidRef for 3D references in getRefTypeSubElements(), which is incorrect. 3D references should be treated as invalid and require 2D references to be provided for validation.
